messages.content: Use at least 75 words in total. (A "word" is a run of English letters A–Z/a–z; apostrophes inside words like "don't" count as part of the word.) Include at least one table in Markdown table format. Any table should be in Markdown table format. Do not use any of these words or phrases: ['rain', 'family']. Make your response end with "still a cat who knew how to belong.".

Write a story about a cat who lost its family. Include at least one table in Markdown table format. Use Markdown table syntax for tables (pipes + dashed separator row). Do not add extra text after "still a cat who knew how to belong."; end the response with it. Do not write fewer than 75 words. (Only English-letter words count; apostrophes inside words are allowed.) Avoid these words/phrases completely: ['rain', 'family'].
